title: NEET PG 2025 Admit Card Out At natboard.edu.in, Here's Direct Link To Download | Education and Career News - News18
text:
NEET PG 2025 Admit Card: The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) on Wednesday released the admit cards for the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test for Postgraduate (NEET PG) 2025. Registered candidates can download their hall tickets from the official website at natboard.edu.in using their user ID and password. The NEET PG 2025 exam is scheduled to be held on August 3, from 9 am to 12:30 pm, in a single shift. The entrance test is conducted for admission to postgraduate medical programmes including MD, MS, Diploma, Post-MBBS DNB, and DrNB courses across India.
The admit card contains crucial details such as the candidate’s name, application ID, roll number, exam date and time, reporting time, exam centre address and code, category, photo ID, and PwD status. Candidates are advised to verify all information thoroughly upon downloading their admit card.
How To Download NEET PG 2025 Admit Card?
Candidates can download their NEET PG 2025 admit card by following these simple steps:
advetisement Step 1: Go to the official website: natboard.edu.in.
Step 2: Click on the NEET PG 2025 admit card notification.
Step 3: Use the login link provided in the notice.
Step 4: Enter your user ID and password to access the portal.
Step 5: Download and save the admit card for future use.
